Following Up an Email in German: B1 Phrase Exercises

Follow up a message politely in German without assuming why no reply arrived. Practise nachfragen, eingegangen and a specific request.

B1 level4 worked examples4 practice questions

Independent practice by Klarweg. Not an official Goethe exam or assessment.

Useful phrases and patterns

A follow-up can refer to the earlier message, state the information still needed and ask whether it was received. Ich wollte kurz nachfragen … is a common soft opening. Ist meine Nachricht bei Ihnen eingegangen? asks about receipt without assuming that the recipient ignored it.

Common mistake to avoid

A missing reply can have different reasons. In the language task, distinguish the observation that you have no reply from a claim about the recipient’s intention.

How to practise: read the examples once, cover the English meanings and try explaining the choice aloud. Next, complete all four questions before opening their answers.

Four German examples with English meanings

Pay attention to the exact article, verb position or ending described in the rule.

Worked example 1Ich wollte zu meiner Nachricht vom Dienstag kurz nachfragen.I wanted to follow up briefly on my message from Tuesday.
Worked example 2Ist meine E-Mail bei Ihnen eingegangen?Did you receive my email?
Worked example 3Für die Planung benötige ich noch Ihre Rückmeldung zur Uhrzeit.For planning I still need your reply about the time.
Worked example 4Falls Sie weitere Angaben brauchen, schicke ich sie gern nach.If you need further information, I will gladly send it.

Practice: complete the phrases

Complete the follow-up message using the vocabulary or participle in brackets. Try each question before opening the answer. A dash (—) means no word is needed. Where another answer is possible, the explanation notes it. These are self-check exercises, not exam scoring.

Word bank: eingegangen · nach · nachfragen · Rückmeldung

Question 1. Ich wollte wegen meiner E-Mail kurz ___. (follow up)

Show answer and explanation for question 1

Answer: nachfragen

Nachfragen asks again about the earlier message.

Question 2. Ist meine Nachricht bei Ihnen ___? (eingehen, Partizip II)

Show answer and explanation for question 2

Answer: eingegangen

The participle of eingehen is eingegangen.

Question 3. Ich benötige noch eine ___ zum vorgeschlagenen Datum. (reply)

Show answer and explanation for question 3

Answer: Rückmeldung

Rückmeldung names the response still needed.

Question 4. Weitere Angaben schicke ich Ihnen gern ___. (nachschicken, prefix)

Show answer and explanation for question 4

Answer: nach

Nachschicken separates into schicke ... nach.

Revise it so it sticks

Return to this lesson tomorrow and complete the four gaps without looking at the rule. Then write two of your own sentences using today's pattern. Check whether the subject, case and verb position match the explanation.
